newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Pictet reiterates hold for Nestle.
newsitem.headline: Pictet reiterates hold for Nestle.

text.p: Pictet & Cie reiterated its hold recommendation for Nestle shares, noting chief financial officer Mario Corti's warning that rising coffee prices could hurt consumption, especially in the United States.

"Mr Corti's comment can be construed as a profit warning ahead of publication of the group's interim sales figures...hinting that the group's volume growth targets are likely to come in towards the lower end of the market's expectations," it said in research note.
It said some analysts may have to downgrade their estimates.
